strategies.name: Detection of Replication Through Removable Media

analytics.name: Analytic 1802
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates a causal chain where a device transitions into USB debugging or file transfer mode after a physical connection event, followed by application installation, file replication, or execution originating from the USB interface rather than the application store ecosystem.

tuning.description: Correlation window between USB connection state change and application installation.
List of devices legitimately allowed to use ADB debugging.
Approved enterprise apps allowed to install outside Google Play.
Volume of file writes from mounted external storage considered suspicious.

log_sources.name: android:MDMLog
log_sources.channel: device USB mode change (charging to file transfer / debugging / accessory)

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: application installed from adb, sideload, or unknown USB source

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: large file write originating from /mnt/usb or external mounted storage

analytics.name: Analytic 1803
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates a chain where a device establishes a new trusted USB host pairing or enters developer/debug configuration state, followed by device data extraction activity, configuration manipulation, or abnormal application behavior shortly after the pairing event.

tuning.description: Time window between trusted host pairing and suspicious device behavior.
Enterprise-authorized computers permitted to pair with managed devices.
Whether developer mode is permitted in the organization.

log_sources.name: iOS:MDMLog
log_sources.channel: Developer Mode enabled, supervised-device restriction changed, or trust-related protected device posture changed

log_sources.name: iOS:MDMLog
log_sources.channel: Trusted computer / host relationship established or relevant device trust setting changed

log_sources.name: iOS:MDMLog
log_sources.channel: Device risk, compliance, or security posture changes after trusted host pairing or developer-state transition

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: Observed device-service, trust-service, backup/service interaction, or other privileged framework activity associated with physical host access
